races.display_title: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Mel Rowley has her string in good nick so the returning JUST IN A BIT is fancied to capitalise on a handy-looking mark (form of his final start at Chepstow has been well advertised) and gain a first win. Moonlightinthepark is feared most on the back of a good recent Worcester second, although both Twist Of Fatecatch and Billy Boi Blue can also play a prominent role. JUST IN A BIT MOONLIGHTINTHEPARK (IRE) TWIST OF FATECATCH (FR)

races.verdict: Lightly-raced hurdler SOUL LIMBO ought to be all the better for a recent pipe-opener on the Flat and looks a potential improver on handicap debut. races.verdict: After a promising start to his career, THE BOSS BEAR 's progress stalled in handicaps last season but he's since joined a yard which has a good record with new recruits. races.display_title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict: Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and CAVAN LADY is fancied to make light of a 2 lb rise for her breakthrough Redcar success and go 2-2 since joining Stephen Hanlon. The reliable Past Passion appeals as the one to give her most to do ahead of nursery debutant Fancied Angel . CAVAN LADY PAST PASSION FANCIED ANGEL
